articles.title: Artemis III: From Historic Moon Landing to Earth-Orbit Tech Demo
articles.summary: NASA's Artemis III crew will not walk on the Moon. Instead, they'll test docking procedures in low Earth orbit. The shift comes after SpaceX Starship delays and a Blue Origin rocket explosion. Commander Randy Bresnik leads the mission, now targeting 2027.

articles.title: Sweden's Digital Reckoning: Nationwide School Phone Ban Starts This Fall
articles.summary: Sweden will ban mobile phones in all schools starting next academic year, prioritizing books over screens. The policy follows falling reading scores—24.3% of ninth graders lack basic comprehension. The government is also investing $59 million in textbooks.

articles.title: 'I Call the Shots': Trump-Netanyahu Rift Exposes Diverging War Aims
articles.summary: A public feud between Trump and Netanyahu reveals a growing crack in U.S.-Israel ties. Trump wants a quick Iran peace deal to avoid midterm backlash; Netanyahu may gain politically from prolonged war. Analysts call the relationship 'transactional.'
